basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old manga enthusiast hailing from the bustling city of Tokyo, Japan. By day, I work as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company, and by night, I dive into the world of manga and fantasy novels. I have a keen interest in legal issues, often visiting the 'law' subreddit to stay updated on global policies. I'm also fascinated by unsolved mysteries, with a particular soft spot for the Grateful Doe case. I'm single, enjoy late-night online sessions, and love discussing storylines and character development with fellow manga fans.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which has equipped me with analytical skills that I apply to both my job and hobbies. My love for manga started in my teens, and over the years, I've read hundreds of titles, giving me a broad understanding of various genres and tropes. I self-teach through reading and engaging in discussions.
